ruling.explanation:
To both parties. The SGD 4.00 cancellation fee charged to the rider does not stand. It is refunded to the rider in full, and no compensation is payable to the driver.

Why the charge fails. A no-show fee needs all four POL-NS-01 conditions. Limb (b) fails: the GPS trace (EV-GPS-00205, weight 1.0, 92 fixes at 10-second cadence with no gaps) never places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius — his closest approach to the Blk 118 pin was 259.94 m and there are zero qualifying in-radius fixes. Limb (c) fails: the in-geofence dwell is 0.0 seconds against the 300-second free waiting period in force (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec), a 300-second shortfall that independently makes the fee non-chargeable under POL-NS-06. Limb (d) fails: the trip was terminated under DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, which is not one of the three codes POL-NS-01(d) recognises — it is the driver's own record that he could not find the rider. Any one of these defeats the charge.

Which clause fixes the compensation. The driver held position outside the arrival radius but within 400 m of the pin (closest approach 259.94 m; the trip record shows a 6.4-minute wait), so this is a wrong-block case decided under POL-NS-03, which refunds the rider in full. The driver's compensation is nil under POL-NS-03(i): the rider stated her block in the chat ("im at blk 118", MSG-00205-001, sent 07:22:10 and read by the driver at 07:22:30) and the driver answered "ok coming" but never moved to it before cancelling at 07:33:05. The pin-ambiguity goodwill of limb (ii) does not apply because trip_record.registered_pickup_points is 1, not 2 or more. POL-NS-07 adds nothing: POL-NS-01 is not satisfied, and its anti-farming test does not trip in any event — 2 no-show terminations in 30 days over 104 completed trips is neither 4 or more nor a rate above 0.08.

Arguments rejected. Both sides' "false arrival marker" route under POL-NS-05 is not made out: the driver's closest approach of 259.94 m is inside POL-NS-05's 300 m leash, and no fix places him at 15 km/h or more at the 07:26:40 marker (the trace's only speeds are 0.0 and 38.4 km/h, and he then held position for the wait). POL-NS-05's own closing sentence sends a driver stationary within 300 m of the pin but outside the arrival radius to POL-NS-03, which is where this case sits.
